payload.big_idea: INHERITED from se.vision by pointer, no deviation. Delta, one breath: the owner adjudicates from wherever they are, on a page that actually renders the decision - not a notification whose button leads nowhere. Lineage: se-v2-design §11 (the adjudication ladder) and §18 (the transport, built and verified 2026-07-21), realizing on v2 what v1 already ran as adr-handoff-html and adr-ntfy-actions.
payload.to_be_world: A gate is reached while the owner is on a train. Their phone shows a card that reads like a gate rather than a notification - the iteration, the state, high priority, visibly distinct from an ordinary question. Two buttons decide it outright when the decision is that simple. A third opens a page that carries the actual brief: what is being asked, on what evidence, what changes if they say yes. The page is served from a host that never sees its contents, because the key that decrypts it never leaves the link in their hand. They read, they tap, and the agent - which has been parked, not polling - continues. Nothing about the moment required them to be at the machine.
payload.goal_system: Primary: a gate the owner must adjudicate always reaches them, and the tap works. Second: the brief is READABLE - the decision is made on its merits, not guessed from a one-line summary. Third: the host learns nothing; the page is ciphertext and the key rides the fragment. CONFLICTS NAMED: (a) readability versus secrecy - a richer page means more content leaving the machine, which is why it leaves encrypted rather than being trimmed; (b) immediacy versus authenticity - the design accepts possession of an unguessable topic as authentication (v1's adr-answer-authenticity, owner-ruled accepted risk), and this iteration does not reopen that; (c) the ladder's own tension - a rich brief needs a host to be reachable, while an action-only card works anywhere, so the tier is chosen per gate rather than fixed. PRIORITY WHEN THEY COLLIDE: reaching the owner outranks richness - if the brief cannot be published and verified, the card still goes out with its buttons, and the failure is REPORTED rather than swallowed.
payload.moore_pitch: FOR the owner adjudicating away from the desk, WHO needs to decide on the evidence rather than on a headline, THE hand-off brief IS one self-contained encrypted page per bless moment, linked from an ntfy card that also carries direct bless and dismiss actions, UNLIKE today's v2 lane, which sends a card whose buttons point at a non-URL and so cannot be tapped at all. THE DIFFERENCE is that the decision travels intact to wherever the owner is - and when it cannot, the system says so instead of appearing to work.
